label: nodesThreadsMap REST API endpoint
type: the REST endpoint that overrides backup:thread-count-setting on a per-node basis.
aliases_note: Minted in round 19 (backup-service.json) under a bare `rest:` namespace - a namespace with no other member anywhere in the registry or corpus, and one that names a part of speech ('a REST endpoint') rather than a subject area, the same defect shape as the retired `setting:` namespace (round 14/15). Renamed into `backup:` on filing, since the endpoint is Backup-Service-specific and the corpus has no second `rest:`-prefixed concept to justify keeping the namespace open. The extraction records keep their original id; `rest:nodes-threads-map` is recorded here as an alias so the write-time gate resolves it correctly.
evidence: You change this setting using the `nodesThreadsMap` REST API endpoint.
The `nodesThreadMap` endpoint lets you change the number of threads the Backup Service uses on a node.
note: Note the source's own spelling drift between `nodesThreadsMap` (plural 'Threads', backup-service.md and the endpoint path itself) and `nodesThreadMap` (singular, backup-node-threads.md's own prose) - not logged as a separate docs-issue, since it is a single-letter, low-impact prose slip rather than a structural inconsistency, but recorded here for anyone reusing this id.
relates_to_competency_question: Which REST endpoint controls the Backup Service's per-node thread count?
